summary: Expired receipts, stale task epochs, prepared crashes and unbound Codex sessions fail closed while refreshed or recovered typed authority applies once.
facts: An expired undecided request was refreshed with a distinct identity and the old receipt could not be replayed.
A task-epoch drift superseded the prepared transaction before apply.
A crash after prepare recovered the same typed request exactly once.
Missing or mismatched Codex session identity failed before any authority write.
